hypothesis: Rank-one restart of unfinished progress can close a run-histogram response family even when operators do not commute on the goal.
trigger: Goal-relative commutation fails but the common reset regenerates every unfinished component.
minimal_test: Heterogeneous DTMCs, exogenous binary Markov work/reset modes, absorbing conjunction, restart law equal to initial law; exact histories, product states and independent renewal evaluator.

refutations.claim: No commutation means full history enumeration is necessary.
refutations.witness: Noncommuting rank-one resets give a closed histogram response.

refutations.claim: Time since last reset summarizes all completion.
refutations.witness: Completed jobs persist across resets; equal final age can hide earlier success.

refutations.claim: Partial reset preserves the same histogram certificate.
refutations.witness: Run orders(1,1,2)/(1,2,1) differ by1/64 under half-reset.

refutations.claim: One reduced backend dominates allN/H regimes.
refutations.witness: Subset-renewal wins at smallN/largeH; histogram wins at largerN/moderateH.

refutations.claim: Green workflow proves a benchmark succeeded.
refutations.witness: First attempt masked API errors through tee; invalid evidence retained; smoke/pipefail fix verified.

contribution_policy: Separate validity, concrete adaptation, priority and fertility. Do not modify global catalogue counts without reconciling existing branch ledgers.
next_gate: A predeclared certified portfolio and external held-out coverage, not broader unsupported SOTA claims.
